mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ofa_activities_review ( activity_id, rating, content, pic, del_flag, user_id, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, appor_by, appor_time, remark ) SELECT DISTINCT a.activity_id, 1 AS rating, NULL AS content, NULL AS pic, 0 AS del_flag, s.user_id, s.dept_id, s.user_id AS create_by, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS create_time, NULL AS update_by, NULL AS update_time, NULL AS appor_by, NULL AS appor_time, '系统默认好评' AS remark FROM ofa_activities a INNER JOIN ofa_activities_signup s ON a.activity_id = s.activity_id LEFT JOIN ofa_activities_review r ON a.activity_id = r.activity_id AND s.user_id = r.user_id WHERE a.appored = 5 AND a.del_flag = 0 AND r.review_id IS NULL ORDER BY a.activity_id, s.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT a.activity_id, a.activity_name, s.user_id, s.dept_id, s.create_time AS signup_time, COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_count FROM ofa_activities a INNER JOIN ofa_activities_signup s ON a.activity_id = s.activity_id LEFT JOIN ofa_activities_review r ON a.activity_id = r.activity_id AND s.user_id = r.user_id WHERE a.appored = 5 AND a.del_flag = 0 AND r.review_id IS NULL ORDER BY a.activity_id, s.user_id
